_how_to_edit: Add a link or code to any item and rebuild. Items with show:false or with no link and no code stay hidden (except checklist items).

sections.title: Day one basics
sections.intro: What to have ready the day a dog comes home with you.

items.name: Slip leash
items.why: Fida Slip Lead, 6 ft. Easy to put on a nervous dog, and hard to back out of.

items.name: Collar with ID
items.why: Joytale collar with a name plate built in. Engrave your phone number in case they slip out.

items.name: Food and water bowls
items.why: Deep stainless steel bowls, 2-pack. Easy to clean and hard to chew.

items.name: Enzyme cleaner
items.why: Nature's Miracle Stain and Odor Remover. Breaks down the smell so accidents don't repeat.

items.name: Poop bags
items.why: Amazon Basics bags with a dispenser that clips to the leash.

items.name: Crate
items.why: MidWest iCrate, double door. Comes in sizes, so pick one by your dog's weight.

sections.title: Worth the splurge
sections.intro: Nice extras if the budget allows.

items.name: Orthopedic bed
items.why: Bedsure orthopedic foam bed. Good for older dogs and dogs who've been sleeping on concrete.

items.name: Harness
items.why: Ruffwear Front Range harness. Padded, two leash spots, and built to last for years of walks.

items.name: GPS tracker
items.why: Tractive GPS tracker for dogs who might slip out. Needs a monthly plan.

items.name: Pet camera
items.why: Furbo 360 camera. Check on them and toss a treat from your phone. Needs a paid plan.

sections.title: Food
sections.intro: Street dogs often have sensitive stomachs. Switch foods slowly over a week.

items.name: Get Joy
items.why: Fresh and freeze-dried dog food, including a beef freeze-dried raw.
items.alt: Get Joy Beef Freeze-Dried Raw dog food bag

items.name: Rigby
items.why: Dog food that new customers can get 15% off through our link.

sections.title: Grooming and coat care
sections.intro: For baths and coat care once your vet gives the OK. Mange and skin infections need a vet first.

items.name: Goldie
items.why: Dog shampoos, wipes, towels, and ear care.

sections.title: Calm and enrichment
sections.intro: Lick mats and chews give an anxious dog something to do besides worry.

items.name: Woof
items.why: Lick pads, pupsicles, and calming treats.

items.name: PetSmart
items.why: Food, crates, beds, and everything else in one stop.
